splitPolicy: Every prediction is out of sample by entire game. No random pitch split is used.

chargeTimingComparison.interpretation: Association only. The charge counter is not an independent batter power/contact timing marker.

swingDecisionRuns.blocker: Behavior can be predicted out of game, but the archive does not identify counterfactual value of the unchosen action.

slapChargeChoice.blocker: Choice is observed, but choice value is confounded with player, character, opponent, and pitch quality.

contactExecutionRuns.blocker: OOF contact and contact-quality checks exist, but the cohort is too small and crossed too sparsely for player-minus-character run attribution.

powerChargeTimingRuns.blocker: Charge duration/release timing comes from the same charge counter; no independent power/contact timing marker exists.

starSwingDecisionRuns.blocker: Star swings are observed, but star availability and shared-resource opportunity cost are not observed in these official games.

automaticCharacterContribution.blocker: Character, automatic animation/route behavior, and player are not sufficiently crossed to separate reliably.

residualOutcomeVariance.blocker: Residual mixes defense, park interactions, automatic behavior, model error, and luck.

totalBattingUva.blocker: Required component run values are not independently identified or adequately calibrated.

unobservedInputs: missed dive/jump/Buddy-action button attempts without animation/contact
independent batter power/contact timing beyond the charge counter
controller side in the official-game cohort
star resource availability before each official pitch
